definitions.name: Door leaf
definitions.definition: physical leaf, bottom edge to top edge
definitions.maskInstruction: Paint the door leaf continuously from its bottom edge to its top edge.

definitions.name: Table top
definitions.maskInstruction: Paint the tabletop edge and a visible floor patch; a connecting stroke is fine.

definitions.name: PC tower
definitions.definition: tower base on tabletop to tower top
definitions.maskInstruction: Paint the tower continuously from its tabletop contact to its top.

definitions.name: Monitor + stand
definitions.definition: stand contact on tabletop to screen top
definitions.maskInstruction: Paint from the stand/table contact to the top of the screen.
definitions.availabilityNote: The laptop occludes the stand/table contact in the recorded clip. Do not grade B4 without another view.

definitions.name: Monitor top
definitions.definition: floor plane to screen top; also checked as B2 + B4
definitions.maskInstruction: Paint the screen top and a visible floor patch; a connecting stroke is fine.
